verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is an API product that is accessed programmatically through OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible SDKs. It documents streaming and non-stream calls, JSON output and concurrency and rate-limit behaviour, so headless, non-interactive automation is inherent to its own documented capability. The evidence never addresses CI specifically: there are no CI integration guides, pipeline examples or official CLI. missing for 10: CI-specific documentation or examples, an official CLI or headless runner, independent hands-on reports of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
